_comment_parallel: parallel_workers: number of threads used for concurrent resource-type discovery within a subscription (networking / VMs / App Services / SQL / Storage / PaaS all run in parallel). Increase for faster runs on large environments (12-20 recommended). git_clone_workers: parallel threads for cloning + scanning git repos.
_comment_read_only: read_only_enforce: when true, a custom HTTP policy is attached to every Azure SDK client that raises RuntimeError if any non-GET HTTP method is attempted. This makes accidental write operations impossible. Recommended: true.
_comment_scan_code: Set scan_code to true to enable Azure DevOps git repo scanning for application-level dependency detection. Requires azure_devops credentials below. Set to false to skip code scanning.
_comment_azure_devops: Configure Azure DevOps org + PAT (Code Read scope). 'projects' lists projects to scan. Leave 'repositories' as [] to AUTO-DISCOVER all repos in that project via the REST API. 'repo_name' is the field name for each repo entry. Set scan_code=true above to enable.
_comment_git_tuning: git_clone_depth: shallow clone depth (1 = fastest). git_clone_workers: parallel repo clone + scan threads (increase for large repo counts). git_max_file_kb: skip files larger than this size. git_scan_extensions: only scan files with these extensions. git_skip_dirs: directory names to skip during scanning.
